data.exact_reserve_text: Prior year reserve releases in 2014 were GBP 22.9m (2013 GBP 40.3m). The surpluses following the reassessment of claims outstanding held at the end of the previous year are as set out below: Total direct 16,297 Reinsurance acceptances 6,657 Total 22,954
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported prior year reserve releases of GBP 22.954 million in 2014, representing a 6.22% release relative to the opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 368.747 million. This favorable development was attributed to the absence of major catastrophe losses and generally favorable claims development from prior periods. The releases were identified across both direct insurance and reinsurance acceptances.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable development of prior year reserves
surpluses following the reassessment of claims outstanding held at the end of the previous year

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of GBP 22.954m is explicitly stated as 'surpluses' in Note 5 and matches the 'Prior year reserve releases' figure in the Strategic Report. While not explicitly labelled 'gross', the breakdown by 'Total direct' and 'Reinsurance acceptances' suggests it represents the overall gross movement for the syndicate. No claims development triangle was found.
